str.split.title: Python String split() Method
str.split.md:
**Python String split() Method**

The split() method splits a string into a list.

**Syntax**

`string.split(separator, maxsplit)`

**Example**

```python
txt = "welcome to the jungle"x = txt.split()
    print(x)
```

Source: https://www.w3schools.com/python/ref_string_split.asp

str.strip.title: Python String strip() Method
str.strip.md:
**Python String strip() Method**

The strip() method removes any leading, and trailing whitespaces.

**Syntax**

`string.strip(characters)`

**Example**

```python
txt = "     banana     "x = 
    txt.strip()
    print("of all fruits", x, "is my favorite")
```

Source: https://www.w3schools.com/python/ref_string_strip.asp
